messages:
Alex L: Quick heads-up — ACMECorp wants to close this quarter. They asked for API + Optimize + Console add-on as a packaged deal. Asking for 30% off list with a 12mo revenue commit. Need deal desk signoff.

Maria G: They ran a 2-week POC and are happy with latency. Security asked for SSO, CSP review, and a limited IP allowlist. Quote at list sits ~ $200k ARR. Can we support 30% or propose tiered commit-based discount?

Kevin (SE): POC notes: Optimize jobs ~10k/day, API ~350k tokens/mo avg. Console usage low. No data residency blocker. SSO via SAML is fine. VPC was an ask but not mandatory.

Sarah (Deal Desk): 30% is above our comp matrix. What commit $ would offset? Need concrete ARR numbers and legal on special terms (data deletion SLA). Please share rate card breakdown.

Alex L: Sharing numbers below: 
```
List:
- API (per-token): $0.0008/token -> est $120k/year
- Optimize (flat): $50k/year
- Console add-on: $30k/year
Total list: $200k/year
Requested discount: 30% -> $140k/year
Requested commit: 12mo -> $140k ARR
```

Sarah (Deal Desk): For 30% we typically want a 2x commit or exec approval. Our standard: >25% discount requires >=2.0x commit or CRO sign-off. Can we do 20% with a 12mo + case study?

Maria G: Customer said exec sponsor (Dir of ML) is willing to do a case study but prefers limited co-marketing. They said they can commit ~1.5x ARR, not 2x. Also asked for Console retention to be 90 days — needs product signoff.

Kevin (SE): On security: we submitted questionnaire v3. Infra flagged KMS/BYOK as a blocker for hosted. Customer prefers Hosted with BYOK. If BYOK not available, they're ok with Dedicated if timeline acceptable.

Liam (Eng-Infra): BYOK for Hosted isn't GA. Option: Dedicated + KMS (lead time ~4–6 weeks). Alternative: contractual mitigations (data segmentation + shorter retention + audit logs). Which path do we prefer?

Bethany (Legal): I can draft SOW addendum for data deletion and audit logging. Need exact language for retention, deletion SLA, and KMS expectations. Recommend "Customer Data deletion within 7 days after termination" + audit log export window.

Jon (RevOps): We can't approve >25% discount without CRO sign-off. Also need to lock ACV in SFDC and set the commit multiple. Please include forecast motion and expected booking date.

Sarah (Deal Desk): I'm opening an exception request form now. Fields needed from seller: final proposed ARR, discount %, commit multiple, security mitigations (BYOK / Dedicated / contractual), requested legal clause text, product signoff on retention, and CRO approval if >25%.

Alex L: I'll fill the form. Proposal to test: 25% discount with 1.5x commit + limited case study + product agrees to 90-day retention for Console. If CRO wants >25% I will escalate.

Maria G: Customer prefers 30% but I can push 25% + 1.5x and see if Dir of ML signs. I'll confirm co-marketing constraints.

Bethany (Legal): Send me the security questionnaire link and the exact data terms you want in the addendum. I'll prepare a draft SOW clause for review.

Liam (Eng-Infra): If we go Dedicated for BYOK, get them to accept 4–6 week SLA on delivery. I can scope the infra work once committed.

Jon (RevOps): Keep me posted. If we land at 25% w/ 1.5x commit, route to CRO for approval but this is likely approvable. >25% = high friction.

Alex L: Ack. I'll attach POC logs, security questionnaire, and draft ARR in the exception form. Will update thread when exec feedback returns. :thumbsup:
